cc:Work.dc:title: News ranking with historical feedback

g.text: selection of an observed clicked candidate. Cold-target metrics require selecting a clicked model-cold candidate.

g.text: Model-cold items are absent from training but may have later reference exposure. Zero-signal targets have no prior

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: reference exposure, global click history or personal click history. Subsets in a and b may share requests.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: Feedback is assumed available after 1 h; receipt times are unavailable. CIs are conditional on this week and reference

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: stream. Panel c is not retrained for each delay. These are same-period offline results, not online CTR or revenue lift.
